name: lyfusion-plugin
description: Lead-sidekick collaboration for Claude Code: Claude plans, reviews and accepts; Codex CLI writes the code, tests and lint fixes in an isolated git worktree, checked by a local engine before anything reaches your branch. Sidekick models: gpt-6-luna (default, high effort), gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra, switched with /fusion model. Requires Python 3.10+, Git and a signed-in Codex CLI. An independent project, not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.
